title: PII gold record (ontology v2)
description: One JSONL row of PII gold under the v2 target ontology. Primary spans carry a BIOES primary class from the 29-class inventory in scripts/pii_tagset_v2.yaml. The optional per-span attrs object holds independent predicate channels over character extents inside the span, so a v1 reader that ignores attrs still reads a valid record. Unknown top-level row fields are provenance and are preserved.
x-loader-enforced-invariants: spans are sorted by (start, end, type)
record ids are unique within a file
an attrs channel is present only on a primary type in its applicable_types
every attribute interval lies inside its primary span
attribute intervals within one channel are pairwise disjoint
dataset metadata declares an attr_channels registry equal to the authoritative one, including each channel's value_kind

id.description: Record identifier, unique within the file.

text.description: Document text. All offsets index this string in Unicode codepoints.

spans.description: Primary spans, sorted by (start, end, type) and non-overlapping.

attrs.description: Independent predicate channels. A present key with a nonempty list gives the known-positive character extents; a present key with an empty list is a known negative; a missing key is unknown and masks loss and evaluation for that channel.

intervals.description: Pairwise-disjoint character extents inside the primary span. Multiple disjoint intervals are valid.

interval.description: Absolute half-open [start, end) Unicode-codepoint interval inside the primary span.

primary_type.description: The 29 adopted primary classes. O is the outside sentinel of the BIOES tagging, never a span type.

attr_channels.description: Must equal the authoritative registry in scripts/pii_tagset_v2.yaml on applicable_types, semantics_version, and value_kind. Undeclared channels are rejected rather than accepted.

dataset_metadata.description: Per-dataset declaration. It lives beside the gold file as <file>.meta.json, either at the top level or nested under an "ontology" key.

value_kind.description: A channel value is a list of character extents inside the primary span, not a scalar or a label.
